text.p: Channell Commercial Corp said Thursday it is increasing finished goods inventory to meet demand.

Second quarter revenue was $15.7 million, a 20.8 percent increase over the same period in 1996. Net income increased 13.6 percent to $2.5 million from $2.2 million pro forma net income in the second quarter of 1996. Net income per share for the period was $0.28 versus adjusted net income per share of $0.25 in 1996.

"Over the last four months, order flow has switched from the first half to the second half of the month," said president Bill Channell. "Consequently, 'just-in-time' customer delivery requirements are resulting in orders placed with expectation of shipment in the same month. We anticipate this trend to continue in the foreseeable future. In response, the company has begun to increase finished goods inventory to meet changing customer demands."
